findings.issue: אֵל is a common masculine singular noun, not an article or a proper name. Spanish «El» leaves that noun untranslated.
רְאֵם is a common masculine singular noun, not a proper name. Spanish «reem» dumps the lemma untranslated.
«traspasará» narrows the qal imperfect to piercing through; the token only licenses a 3ms strike/wound.

notes: Remaining tokens match stem, person, number, suffixes, Egipto, and the asyndeton before the 3mp bones.
